claim: The only 2026 Czech shareholder acts (SL95 dated 24.6.2026 and SL94 dated 20.7.2026, signed in Utrecht) contain no corporate action beyond approving FY2025 accounts, carrying forward the CZK 662,929.19 loss, noting the related-party report, and replacing Gozde Sen Lonell with Reid Joshua Sigal as jednatel. No capital, object, branch, dissolution or dividend resolution. Unlike the FY2024 resolution (SL91, 16.7.2025), which appointed KPMG Ceska republika Audit as FY2025 auditor, the 2026 acts appoint no FY2026 auditor. Both shareholders are Foot Locker Europe B.V. (KvK 23067735) and Foot Locker Netherlands B.V. (KvK 23063181), Stationsplein 32, Utrecht.
